title: HackerTube keeps the videos Hacker News already recommended
friendlyTitle: A new site plays videos that Hacker News recommended
summary: Andrej Karpathy has published HackerTube, a site of videos that people on Hacker News have recommended. It needs no login, and it shows a frame from the video rather than a designed thumbnail. He has said on X that Claude did nearly all of the build.
friendlySummary: Andrej Karpathy made HackerTube, a simple site of videos people on Hacker News have recommended. You do not need an account. He has said on X that Claude did almost all of the building.
whyItMatters: It is a working example of a small product assembled by directing an agent, and a watch list that is not ranked by a clickbait thumbnail. The selection is whatever Hacker News argued for, which is a bias of its own.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It is a real product made by telling an agent what to build, and a watch list that does not use clickbait pictures. The list still follows what one community likes.
